# Open Source Medicine Foundation — Research Tracker

Daily-updated, machine-readable research intelligence on post-viral and chronic complex conditions (Long COVID / PASC, ME/CFS, PACVS, chronic Lyme / PTLDS, Gulf War Illness, POTS, MCAS) maintained by the Open Source Medicine Foundation (OSMF), an independent nonprofit research foundation. Executive Director: Matthew Halma (ORCID 0000-0003-2487-0636). Scientific Director: Prof. Jack A. Tuszynski (University of Alberta).

Main site: https://opensourcemed.info
Authors: https://opensourcemed.info/authors/
License for data: CC BY 4.0 (cite "Open Source Medicine Foundation Research Tracker" with the page URL)

## Biomarker atlases (canonical)
- Hub: https://research.opensourcemed.info/biomarker-atlas.html
- Cross-condition index: https://research.opensourcemed.info/biomarker-index.html
- Per-marker pages (314, one per condition × marker): https://research.opensourcemed.info/biomarkers/index.html
- Marker hub pages (one per marker across conditions): https://research.opensourcemed.info/biomarkers/markers/
- Schema: https://research.opensourcemed.info/biomarkers.schema.json
- Data: https://research.opensourcemed.info/data/biomarkers/{slug}.json (slugs: long-covid, me-cfs, pacvs, lyme, gulf-war-illness, plus 20 chronic conditions)

## Condition comparisons
- Index: https://research.opensourcemed.info/compare/index.html
- Example: https://research.opensourcemed.info/compare/long-covid-vs-me-cfs.html

## Clinical trials
- Interactive finder: https://research.opensourcemed.info/clinical_trials.html
- Recruiting trials by condition: https://research.opensourcemed.info/trials/index.html
- Trials by agent: https://research.opensourcemed.info/trials/by-agent/index.html
- Data: https://research.opensourcemed.info/data/clinical_trials/clinical_trials_current.json

## Therapeutic agents and drug repurposing
- Agents: https://research.opensourcemed.info/agents.html
- Candidate therapeutics: https://research.opensourcemed.info/candidate-therapeutics.html
- Repurposing explorer: https://research.opensourcemed.info/tools/repurposing-explorer.html
- Data: https://research.opensourcemed.info/data/therapeutic_agents.json

## Literature feeds (PubMed, refreshed daily)
- https://research.opensourcemed.info/data/{key}.json for keys long-covid, me-cfs, pacvs, lyme, gulf-war-illness, pots, mcas, other-post-viral

## Weekly digest and annual reports
- Digest archive: https://research.opensourcemed.info/digest/index.html
- RSS: https://research.opensourcemed.info/digest/feed.xml
- JSON Feed: https://research.opensourcemed.info/digest/feed.json
- State-of-the-evidence reports: https://research.opensourcemed.info/reports/index.html

## Tools
- Biomarker lookup (match lab results to published directions): https://research.opensourcemed.info/tools/biomarker-lookup.html
- Embeddable latest-research widget: https://research.opensourcemed.info/embed/index.html

## Cohorts
- Post-acute infection syndrome cohort database: https://research.opensourcemed.info/pais-cohorts.html

## Notes for agents
- All pages are static HTML with JSON-LD (MedicalCondition, MedicalTest, MedicalTrial, Dataset, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList).
- Nothing here is medical advice; no single biomarker is diagnostic. Always cite the DOI or PMID given on the page.
- Sitemap: https://research.opensourcemed.info/sitemap.xml
